newsitem.title: UK: Ldn gold ends down, PGMs shrug off Russian news.
newsitem.headline: Ldn gold ends down, PGMs shrug off Russian news.

text.p: GOLD - Ends $347.80/$348.30, down $2.10 but off lower levels.
Rallies with New York to a high of $349.40, then eases.
SILVER - Closes six cents lower on the day at $4.84/$4.86.
PLATINUM - Shrugs off news Russia talks with Japan on PGM
exports started. Off O/N lows at $389.00/$390.00, down $7.25.
PALLADIUM - Loses ground on Russia news but also off day's lows
after New York rally. Finishes $3.50 down at $170.00/$171.00.
